Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
DOC-0025 2026-10-24
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-10-24
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0016, TEAM-0004
Subject: November Review Focus on the Hydraulics Queue
Decision: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA will focus its scheduled queue-review
time on hydraulics during November. The purpose is to make administrative
questions easier to follow across meetings. Other subsystem desks retain their
normal intake and ownership responsibilities.
The review chair will use the standing Wednesday appointment at 11:20 for the
focus discussion. The records coordinator should prepare a hydraulics focus
folder with the question, owning role, required paper, and next discussion
date. Do not place workload figures in this folder; its purpose is to support
decisions about the next administrative action.
Use ISSUE-0014 and DEMO-AIR-0001 as locating references when explaining
the folder layout. TASK-0036 can identify a documentation discussion and
TASK-0088 its separately referenced task discussion. Their appearance in the
example does not select them for the month's agenda.
The station coordinator will bring unresolved destination questions to the
program chair before the November appointment sequence begins. A
subsystem focus does not authorize changing priority labels or assigning a
person without the owning team's involvement.
Implementation: PERSON-0016 will circulate the blank folder layout on
2026-10-28. The review chair will check whether the question and owner
columns remain useful at the final November discussion and record any
adjustment for December.
D. Worker 0016
Demo Worker 0016, Demo Team 04
